description.zh-CN: 用每日三项重点和轻量周复盘，把待办、日程、精力与长期方向重新对齐。
description.en-US: Align tasks, schedule, energy, and longer-term direction through three daily priorities and a lightweight weekly review.

capabilities.zh-CN: 生成现实的每日三项重点
用成果、阻碍和精力做晚间回顾
capabilities.en-US: Reflect on wins, friction, and energy

capabilities.zh-CN: 完成清理、回顾与下周聚焦
capabilities.en-US: Clear loose ends and focus the next week

examples.zh-CN: 根据这些待办和会议，帮我排今天的三件重点。
examples.en-US: Use these tasks and meetings to plan my top three for today.

examples.zh-CN: 带我做一个十分钟的晚间回顾。
examples.en-US: Guide me through a ten-minute evening reflection.

examples.zh-CN: 用这周的记录做周复盘，并定下周三个结果。
examples.en-US: Review these weekly notes and choose three outcomes for next week.

boundary.zh-CN: 不会连接或修改日历、邮箱和任务系统；所有信息由用户粘贴或上传，计划需用户确认。
boundary.en-US: Does not connect to or modify calendars, email, or task systems; all inputs are pasted or uploaded and plans require user confirmation.

sources.modifications: Retained intention setting, top-three priorities, schedule and energy checks, wins, learning, and tomorrow preview; removed system integrations.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Reviewed as prose. No automation, external calls, or executable content was included.

sources.modifications: Adapted the clear-current-creative weekly review into a short user-led workflow; removed Google, Gmail, WhatsApp, MCP, file commands, and reminders.
sources.securityReviewNotes: External services, command examples, and automatic scheduling were removed.
